result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but there are clear data/rendering defects and horizontal clipping that make the restaurant content look broken.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays the invalid price text "€NaN delivery", indicating a missing or malformed delivery-fee value.
issues.suggestion: Validate and format delivery-fee data before rendering; show a valid fee, "Free delivery", or a deliberate fallback such as "Delivery fee unavailable" instead of NaN.

issues.description: The horizontal "Fastest near you" restaurant carousel is visibly cut off on the right: the third restaurant image, name ("Trattoria Piccol…"), and its delivery text extend beyond the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Use a properly clipped horizontal scroll container with intentional card widths and spacing, or ensure the final visible card fits within the viewport. Avoid exposing truncated text/content without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The category chip row is also cut off at the right edge, leaving part of an additional chip visible without context.
issues.suggestion: Implement the chip row as an intentionally horizontally scrollable list with edge padding/scroll indicators, or fit the available categories within the viewport.

issues.description: The next popular restaurant card is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation, making the content behind it feel cropped.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.
